77828.subject: Bitcoin's Biggest Week Since the 2024 Election
77828.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[Bitcoin](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-reaches-79-500-as-2-75-billion-liquidation-claim-lacks-detail)**[ posts its biggest week since the 2024 election](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-reaches-79-500-as-2-75-billion-liquidation-claim-lacks-detail)

* **[Solana](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/solana-activates-350-millisecond-slots-on-mainnet)**[ cuts slot times to 350 milliseconds on mainnet](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/solana-activates-350-millisecond-slots-on-mainnet)

* **[MANTRA](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/mantra-halts-chain-blames-cosmos-evm-module)**[ halts its chain and blames the Cosmos EVM module](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/mantra-halts-chain-blames-cosmos-evm-module)

* **[A judge](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/judge-keeps-justin-sun-world-liberty-claims-in-court)**[ keeps Justin Sun's World Liberty claims in open court](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/judge-keeps-justin-sun-world-liberty-claims-in-court)

* **[Circle](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/circle-targets-sept-16-for-arc-public-mainnet-launch)**[ targets Sept. 16 for Arc's public mainnet](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/circle-targets-sept-16-for-arc-public-mainnet-launch)

* **[Why DeFi needs onchain insurance](https://thedefiant.io/education/research-and-opinion/defi-needs-onchain-insurance-100-billion-coverage-gap)**[: the $100 billion coverage gap (Partner)](https://thedefiant.io/education/research-and-opinion/defi-needs-onchain-insurance-100-billion-coverage-gap)

Bitcoin gained 22.6% in seven days. The last time it moved that fast was the week after the 2024 election.

Bitcoin changed hands at $76,977 on Friday, up 6.4% over 24 hours, after [a three-day rally broke the $59,000-to-$67,000 range it had held for seven weeks.](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-reaches-79-500-as-2-75-billion-liquidation-claim-lacks-detail) Ether added 28.8% on the week, XRP 36.7% and Solana 21.5%. US spot bitcoin ETFs took in $606.3 million on Thursday, the largest daily intake since May 1, with BlackRock's IBIT accounting for $503 million of it.

Perpetual funding stayed close to zero the whole way up: OKX's BTC-USDT swap paid 0.0100% on Friday with the perpetual trading below index. Nobody bid up the cost of long exposure. Shorts closing out and spot fund buying carried the move, which is what the roughly $3 billion of liquidations around Wednesday's break, more than 90% of them shorts, describes.

77825.subject: 🟪 The Chain Wars
77825.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/9f199753-ca31-4e3d-9435-5e12896ecff5/BD_NL_Banner_Heading.png?t=1781793903)
Caption: 

----------
Happy Friday! We’ve got a [0xResearch](https://x.com/0xResearch) takeover today, and there’s nothing like rounding out the week with some market analysis to mull over. So prepare for battle…the chain wars are underway. 


----------View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e60d7cde-4250-41f8-9443-28ed51b80560/divider_transparent.png?t=1774649182)
Caption: 

# The Chain Wars: Robinhood vs Base

Earlier this month, 0xResearch published a [report](https://app.blockworksresearch.com/research/robinhood-chain-can-it-move-robinhood-s-bottom-line) on Robinhood Chain and its blistering launch. Robinhood Chain had completely upended the L2 market and had become the number one L2 by revenue in just its first month of being live. At $3.6M of chain revenue and 38% of all L2 revenue in July, it was undoubtedly one of the most impressive launches of any chain in recent memory. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/b48c2c3f-ed77-461a-8021-f32e511c211a/image.png?t=1787327904)
Caption: 

However, underpinning this success was a massive wave of memecoin activity that accounted for over 50% of spot volume. Given how fickle and rotational memecoin activity can be, it is worth checking in on Robinhood Chain to see whether it is building on its successful launch or whether activity is decaying as memecoins rotate back to Solana. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/506cd993-44ba-46bd-8cef-18ff91b2689f/image.png?t=1787327904)
Caption: 

Based on its month-to-date run rate, Robinhood Chain is still projected to be the number one L2 by revenue in August, with $2.9M. However, one could argue that cracks are starting to emerge. Firstly, revenue is down 19% MoM, potentially a sign that July’s revenue numbers were in fact due to Robinhood Chain being the “new blockchain.” Second, this August projection is based on revenue through August 21. However, the last seven days show a different picture. Base generated $701,400 in revenue, surpassing Robinhood Chain’s $449,000. Perhaps the [calls](https://x.com/RuneCrypto_/status/2078296367672316353?s=20) for the fall of Base were a bit too premature.

Anyways, one must tread with caution when examining a small data set of just three weeks, but a clearer picture of the L2 landscape is starting to emerge. Yes, Robinhood Chain is certainly here to stay, but it will have to fight tooth and nail with Base over the top spot.
